notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32792711/e2bec04733f3e8fbba9acf03d6ef7311427b2f16.png[/img]

New designs for enemy ships and environment and new design elements for design maker (to player's ship).

17 enemy ship type in the game.

You can fight with other character in a tactical duel. The characters have three types of weapons (sword, shield, bow).

The process of battle:
[list]
[*] the sword's damage to the shield is effective
[*] the shield's damage to the bow is effective
[*] the bow's damage to the sword is effective
[/list]
You can win if you attack the enemy character with the right weapon.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32792711/604ec27e451f6d0d42ba681dc384c5ea99e15984.png[/img]
